Gold at $4,670+, JPM targeting $5,055 by Q4. Extreme fear (F&G 19), active war, weakening DXY (99.8), central bank buying all drive safe-haven flows. Gold miners (NEM, GOLD, AEM) have massive operating leverage to gold price. GDX up 135% from Jan lows.

Defensive positioning in extreme fear environment. Nuclear utility demand rising from hyperscaler contracts (Meta buying 2,176 MW from Ohio plants). Rate-sensitive but Fed on hold helps. Stable cash flows in uncertain times.

Mixed signals. AMD surging on $60B Meta deal (+3.47% last session). NVDA faces competitive narrative pressure. AI capex exceeding $600B in 2026 is structural tailwind. But tariffs, H-1B cost increases, and Taiwan risk create headwinds. Breadth divergence warns narrow leadership is fragile.

LLY blockbuster Foundayo approval is company-specific positive. But 100% pharma tariffs on imports slam NVO, AZN, GSK. Medicare drug negotiation caps pricing. Mixed sector — pick individual names, not sector bets.

Netflix earnings this week — upgraded to Buy. META pivoting hard to AI from VR (Reality Labs cuts). Google antitrust ruling imminent. Sector-specific stories dominate. No clear directional bias.

Food inflation risk from oil-driven transport costs despite stable farm prices. Tariff pass-through to consumer. Traditionally defensive but input costs rising. La Nina risk to agricultural supply adds uncertainty.

Consumer confidence at 91.8 but spending intent weak. Tariffs (10.3% effective rate) squeezing retail margins. Oil-driven transport costs rising. Import-dependent manufacturers hit. Gap, Dollar Tree not factoring tariff costs into guidance. Value-focused consumers are trading down.

Jet fuel at $195/bbl (+103% MoM). Most US carriers unhedged. DAL has refinery hedge (partial buffer) but still facing massive cost pressure. Guidance range wide ($0.50-$0.90 EPS). Regime underweight airlines confirmed. Earnings April 8 is binary risk event.

analysis.contrarian: WHAT EVERYONE IS FOCUSED ON: Iran war, oil prices, defense stocks, gold safe haven. WHAT IS BEING MISSED: (1) March CPI on April 10 could show first signs of oil pass-through to core inflation — if hot, it kills remaining rate cut expectations and slams growth stocks. This is a HUGE binary event in 4 days that nobody is pricing correctly because the war dominates headlines. (2) The breadth divergence is a critical warning — S&P up 6% last week but only 48.3% of stocks above 200 DMA. This rally is extremely narrow and vulnerable to rotation. (3) Novo Nordisk resilience (+2.6% on LLY Foundayo day) suggests the oral GLP-1 competitive threat is already priced in — contrarian long opportunity. (4) BOJ April rate hike could trigger yen carry-trade unwind, which historically causes sharp global equity selloffs (see Aug 2024). (5) The negative gamma regime means any directional move will be amplified — dealers must chase, creating potential flash-crash or flash-rally dynamics. (6) Nuclear energy stocks (CCJ, SMR, OKLO) are under-followed relative to the structural hyperscaler demand story (Meta buying 2,176 MW from Ohio plants, TerraPower partnership).
